final: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, COUNT(*) AS source_size, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(source_size) AS average_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(source_stats.average_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(source_stats.source_size) AS combined_size, AVG(source_stats.source_size - overall.average_size) AS average_excess_size FROM source_stats CROSS JOIN overall WHERE source_stats.source_size > overall.average_size
